name: ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion + ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
description: Create a new version of an existing EC2 launch template, embedding a malicious user-data script and explicitly setting a privileged IAM instance profile. Set the new version as the default. Trigger an Auto Scaling Group to launch an instance — the ASG service role holds iam:PassRole, so the attacker avoids the PassRole requirement — and let the user-data script attach AdministratorAccess to the starting principal.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must be able to create a new version of the target launch template
Must be able to modify the target launch template to set the new version as default
Must be able to set ASG desired capacity to trigger an instance launch

additional.description: Useful for viewing current default version configuration
Used to discover ASGs using the target launch template
Useful for verifying privilege escalation success

admin: An existing EC2 launch template must exist that the starting principal can create new versions of
An Auto Scaling Group must use the target launch template as its launch template
A privileged IAM instance profile must exist that the ASG service role can pass
The privileged instance profile role must have permissions to call iam:AttachUserPolicy
lateral: An existing EC2 launch template must exist with elevated IAM instance profile accessible via an ASG

references.title: IAM permissions required for Amazon EC2 launch templates (AWS Documentation)
Actions defined by Amazon EC2 - Service Authorization Reference

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

options.name: LAUNCH_TEMPLATE_NAME
options.description: Name of the existing target launch template

options.name: ASG_NAME
options.description: Name of the Auto Scaling Group to trigger for instance launch (avoids iam:PassRole requirement) [auto]

options.name: INSTANCE_PROFILE
options.description: ARN or name of the privileged IAM instance profile to embed in the new template version [auto]

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role ARN/name to receive elevated permissions (used by backdoor/attach-policy payload)

options.name: WAIT_FOR_POLICY
options.description: Poll for IAM policy attachment after instance launch (up to 5 minutes, from demo_attack.sh)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Restore original default version after execution
